listOfReactions.name: hexokinase synthesis
listOfReactions.xml:
<reaction metaid="meta_HEX1SYNTHESIS" sboTerm="SBO:0000176" id="HEX1SYNTHESIS" name="hexokinase synthesis" reversible="false" fast="false" compartment="cyto">
  <annotation>
    <rdf:RDF xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#" xmlns:dcterms="http://purl.org/dc/terms/" xmlns:vCard="http://www.w3.org/2001/vcard-rdf/3.0#" xmlns:vCard4="http://www.w3.org/2006/vcard/ns#" xmlns:bqbiol="http://biomodels.net/biology-qualifiers/" xmlns:bqmodel="http://biomodels.net/model-qualifiers/">
      <rdf:Description rdf:about="#meta_HEX1SYNTHESIS">
        <bqbiol:is>
          <rdf:Bag>
            <rdf:li rdf:resource="https://identifiers.org/SBO:0000176"/>
          </rdf:Bag>
        </bqbiol:is>
      </rdf:Description>
    </rdf:RDF>
  </annotation>
  <listOfProducts>
    <speciesReference species="hex1" stoichiometry="1" constant="true"/>
  </listOfProducts>
  <kineticLaw>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <ci> HEX1SYNTHESIS_k </ci>
    </math>
  </kineticLaw>
</reaction>

listOfReactions.name: hexokinase
listOfReactions.xml:
<reaction metaid="meta_HEX1" sboTerm="SBO:0000176" id="HEX1" name="hexokinase" reversible="false" fast="false" compartment="cyto">
  <annotation>
    <rdf:RDF xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#" xmlns:dcterms="http://purl.org/dc/terms/" xmlns:vCard="http://www.w3.org/2001/vcard-rdf/3.0#" xmlns:vCard4="http://www.w3.org/2006/vcard/ns#" xmlns:bqbiol="http://biomodels.net/biology-qualifiers/" xmlns:bqmodel="http://biomodels.net/model-qualifiers/">
      <rdf:Description rdf:about="#meta_HEX1">
        <bqbiol:is>
          <rdf:Bag>
            <rdf:li rdf:resource="https://identifiers.org/SBO:0000176"/>
          </rdf:Bag>
        </bqbiol:is>
      </rdf:Description>
    </rdf:RDF>
  </annotation>
  <listOfReactants>
    <speciesReference species="glc" stoichiometry="1" constant="true"/>
  </listOfReactants>
  <listOfProducts>
    <speciesReference species="glc6p" stoichiometry="1" constant="true"/>
  </listOfProducts>
  <listOfModifiers>
    <modifierSpeciesReference species="hex1"/>
  </listOfModifiers>
  <kineticLaw>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <divide/>
        <apply>
          <times/>
          <ci> HEX1_Vmax </ci>
          <ci> hex1 </ci>
          <ci> glc </ci>
        </apply>
        <apply>
          <plus/>
          <ci> HEX1_Km_glc </ci>
          <ci> glc </ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </kineticLaw>
</reaction>

models.name: model with multiple substance units
models.notes:
Example model for multiple substance units

The substance units for species are restricted to a single substance unit so that reaction rates are in [substance_units/time_units] in an SBML model.

Applying species conversion factors allows to have distinct subsets of species with different units in a single model.

A typical example is the combination of metabolic compounds (simple chemicals) often in mmole with proteins in a single model.
